ADC_APEX_ACTION_ITEMS

Table to store initial references between page items and APEX actions.

Columns
caai_caa_id

Part of PK, Reference to ADC_APEX_ACTION

caai_cpi_crg_id

Part of PK, Reference to ADC_PAGE_ITEM

caai_cpi_id

Part of PK, Reference to ADC_PAGE_ITEM

caai_active

Flag to indicate whether page item shall be connected with this action initially

References
caai_caa_id

references ADC_APEX_ACTIONS (caa_id)

caai_cpi_crg_id, caai_cpi_id

references ADC_PAGE_ITEMS (cpi_crg_id, cpi_id)
